category_title: Students with AS/ADHD experiencing sensory overload and executive function difficulties
scenario_title: Emotional withdrawal and task avoidance during lessons
minimal_context: The student is in the classroom during a lesson and is expected to turn in homework and participate in class activities.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please take out your homework assignments so we can start the lesson.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I didn't do it. I remember having a hard time learning things, especially maths, which I still struggle with.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Why did you not do your homework? You need to get to grips with schoolwork.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Because I just felt so depressed, that I just sat there even though I didn’t want to and couldn’t stand it, I just sat there, just to try to make time pass.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You can't just sit there quietly during the lessons. You need to participate and try working with your classmates.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I’ve never felt that I belonged anywhere or with classmates. I didn’t feel like a proper human being. It feels as if you’re lying on the ground and everybody’s just stepping on you.
